notes.content:

notes.title: (Update for Mac Users) Patch Notes [Ver.2.2.5]
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Koi-Koi Japan.

We have released the long-awaited 64-bit compatible update for the Mac version.
※ Please note: This update is for the Mac version only.

With this update, the minimum supported macOS version has changed as follows:

Before: macOS 10.9.2 or later
After: macOS 10.13.0 or later

We sincerely apologize for the long wait and thank you for your patience.

We are also working on the next update, and we look forward to bringing you more improvements soon.

Thank you for your continued support of Koi-Koi Japan.

notes.title: Upcoming Update Notice
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Koi-Koi Japan.

We will soon be releasing an update for the Mac version to support 64-bit architecture.
With this update, the minimum supported macOS version will change as follows:

Before: macOS 10.9.2 or later
After: macOS 10.13.0 or later

We sincerely apologize for the delay in providing this support and any inconvenience it may have caused.

Moving forward, we plan to improve the system, add more language options, and respond to feedback received through the Community Hub.
If you have any requests regarding language support, we would be very happy to hear from you.

As Koi-Koi Japan celebrates its 10th anniversary, we truly appreciate your continued support.

notes.title: Update [ver2.2.2]
notes.content:
Included in this update: 
* Added a Halloween themed background in the game 
* Added additional functionality to cancel or decline multiplayer games. 
* Changed the ranking calculation. Now if one player in a multiplayer quits 
then it will count as a loss and the other player will get counted as a win. 

* This update also includes several bug fixes.

notes.title: Updated [ver2.0.0]
notes.content:
Online Multiplayer support added!! [ver2.0.0]


Many players have been asking and we’re excited to announce that Koi-Koi
Japan now supports Steam online multiplayer games!

Also in this update:
 * Steam achievements have been added
 * We’ve redesigned the main screen
 * Several minor bugs from the previous version are fixed
 * Some additional effects have been added

It’s a big update and we don’t think there should be any problems.
However if you notice a bug please post in the forum and we’ll try to fix
right away.

Some things we’re still working on:
 * Some German translation remains
 * Additional types of multiplayer rankings to be added
